viewMode.description: The view mode of the grid.

treeView.description: Config to show grid as a treeView.

detailComponent.description: When a component is provided, it is shown as detail when a row is expanded.

canAddRow.description: When true, a new row can be added in the grid.

checkBoxes.description: Show checkboxes in the first column if true.

pageSize.description:
Defines the number of data items show on each page that is used by the Grid pager.
It is applicable when the {@link viewMode} is {@link UiSdlViewGridViewMode#INFINITE_SCROLL} or {@link UiSdlViewGridViewMode#PAGINATION}.

rowActions.description: The set of row-specific actions to be rendered in each row.

canDeleteRow.description:
When true, rows can be deleted from the grid.
If grid has checkboxes, the `Delete` button appears in the filter bar.
If grid does not have checkboxes, `Delete` icon appears on hovering over a row.

paginationConfig.description:
Configures the pager of the Grid.
It is only applicable when the {@link viewMode} is {@link UiSdlViewGridViewMode#PAGINATION}

rowConfig.description: Configures the style and density of the rows in the Grid.

title: Configuration type for the grid section of the {@link UiSdlDataGrid} component.
name: UiSdlDataGridConfig
